name: copy_sixteen_longwords_to_pointer
description: Copies sixteen 32-bit values from a fixed offset in a base-register block into the address passed on the stack, when that address is non-null. It then makes an indirect call through a function pointer held in a register.

name: initialise_disk_validation_state
description: Program entry for the disk-validator file. It stores computed values into a state table derived from base-register fields, loops over table entries, and makes repeated indirect library calls through a function pointer.

name: start_program_and_dispatch
description: Program entry that stores task and library values in globals and then branches on a field of the current task. One branch sets up library state; the other finds the current task and builds a buffer from the argument string before calling the max-finding routine.

name: release_recorded_resources
description: Releases resources recorded in globals, each only if it is nonzero, by calling library routines through pointers. It then makes two more library calls and returns the stored value.

name: invoke_two_function_pointers
description: Calls two library functions in sequence through function pointers at fixed negative offsets from the library base register, then returns.

name: open_library_then_release
description: Opens a library by name, using the dos.library text, and stores the returned base. It then makes a further library call and runs the same resource release as the exit path.

name: parse_command_line_tokens
description: Splits a null-terminated text into space-separated tokens, allowing double-quoted tokens, and stores each token's start in a global table while terminating tokens in place. Afterwards it either opens a named file and records the current task, or fetches the standard input and output handles and opens a second file.

name: allocate_and_init_block
description: Allocates a memory block sized to the requested length plus a fixed header and returns zero on failure. It stores the total size in the header, passes the block to another routine with a global value, and returns the address just past the header.

name: allocate_or_return_minus_one
description: Calls the block allocation routine with the requested size and returns its result when it succeeds. On failure it returns minus one instead.

name: return_minus_one
description: Returns the value with all bits set, which is minus one, and does nothing else. It is reached only as unreferenced code.

name: free_linked_memory_blocks
description: Walks a singly linked list whose head is held in a global. For each node it frees the node's memory using the size stored in that node, then moves to the next node until the list is empty.

name: append_node_to_list
description: Appends a node to a list described by a head and a tail pointer. It clears the node's link, links the previous tail to the node and updates the tail; when the list was empty the head is set to the node as well.

name: record_file_size_and_tokenize
description: Locks a named file and examines it, recording the file size from the examine result when that succeeds, then unlocks it. It then splits the argument text into tokens in the same way as the command-line parser.

name: write_or_read_file_buffer
description: Computes a length and, when it is nonzero, opens the named file for writing in one mode or for reading in another. It seeks to the start, transfers the buffer, and closes the file.

name: rotate_view_history_and_load
description: Shifts a set of saved global values one slot down a history, storing the current values in the new slots, and then loads the view from the named view structure.

name: initialise_display_and_interrupts
description: Opens the graphics library and a temporary window to read the display layout, then closes them with the Workbench and removes the task. It allocates and installs an interrupt server, then initialises the view, viewport, bitmaps and colour map before loading the view.

name: init_state_and_poll
description: Initialises a block of state fields through a base register, then loops calling routines until a value read from the same block equals one of two specific code values. The routine contains a decoder fragment flagged as bad instruction data, which is not behaviour.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Contains only a decoding fragment that XORs a word in memory with a register and then truncates. It is bad data rather than a working routine.

name: update_four_indexed_entries
description: Loops four times. Each pass writes a fixed value and a value based on the loop index into two byte fields of a base-register block, then calls three routines.

name: poll_input_until_end_code
description: Clears several flag fields, then loops calling routines and checking a value read from the block against two end codes. Inside the loop it decodes bits from a counter and writes table values before branching to shared blocks.

name: dispatch_state_by_input_code
description: Chooses the next state from a code returned by a routine, branching over several code ranges. It adjusts byte fields in the shared block and calls routines to write values for each branch.

name: copy_state_and_dispatch_mode
description: Copies two state bytes into their paired slots, sets two fixed byte fields and decrements a counter when it is nonzero. It then branches on a mode value and an earlier result to run one of several groups of routines.

name: toggle_bit_zero_and_dispatch
description: Toggles bit zero of a global flag and then runs the same mode-based dispatch code as its neighbours, sharing the state bytes.

name: toggle_bit_one_and_dispatch
description: Toggles bit one of a global flag and then runs the same mode-based dispatch code as its neighbours, sharing the state bytes.

name: select_sequence_by_index
description: Switches on a small index and runs one of several short sequences. Each sequence writes state fields and calls routines, and some cases store a fixed table byte.

name: enter_shared_state_update
description: Enters the common state update block. It calls a stub and two routines, then continues into the shared dispatch code.

name: start_shared_state_update
description: Enters the common state update block through a short prologue of three calls, then continues into the shared dispatch code.

name: enter_shared_dispatch_tail
description: Three-instruction entry into the shared dispatch block. It calls two routines before the common state update continues.

name: fill_indexed_slot_or_reuse
description: Calls a routine to obtain a value, then either stores it in a global table slot and adds it to a running total, or reads the existing slot value. It then runs a loop that copies the adjusted value through a pointer.

name: copy_bytes_to_indexed_pointer
description: Calls two routines and then, when a flag condition holds, copies bytes from a source address into the buffer whose address is held in a table slot. The length is taken from the slot value.

name: find_table_entry_by_key
description: Scans a zero-terminated table of 32-bit entries for the value in the data register. It returns when it finds a match or reaches the terminating zero entry.

name: call_blit_bitmap
description: Calls the graphics library bit-map blit routine through a library base pointer held in a global, then returns with no other work.

name: call_init_raster_port
description: Calls the graphics library routine that initialises a raster port, through a library base pointer held in a global, and then returns.

name: call_merge_copper_list
description: Calls the graphics library routine that merges copper lists, through a library base pointer held in a global, and then returns.

name: call_make_viewport
description: Calls the graphics library routine that builds a viewport, through a library base pointer held in a global, and then returns.

name: call_free_sprite
description: Calls the graphics library routine that frees a hardware sprite, through a library base pointer held in a global, and then returns.

name: fill_table_and_index_calls
description: Fills twenty entries of a global table with values returned by a routine. It then calls a routine once for each index up to a count held in a global, and finally calls a routine with its two arguments.

name: copy_two_saved_globals
description: Calls a routine, copies one saved global into another slot, calls the routine again and copies a second saved global into the same slot.

name: scroll_raster_clip_region
description: Calls the graphics library raster scroll routine to move the raster down by eight lines inside a fixed clip rectangle. The rectangle spans horizontal positions 192 to 319 and vertical positions 136 to 199.

name: return_fixed_constant
description: Returns one fixed 32-bit constant and does nothing else.

name: pack_check_result_pair
description: Calls a routine and returns a 64-bit pair. The high word is a fixed constant when that call returns zero and zero otherwise; the low word is the second argument.

name: return_constant_with_stack_argument
description: Returns a pair of values: a fixed constant in the high word and the first stack argument in the low word.

name: read_pointer_movement_and_sprite
description: Reads mouse movement from the port register and keeps a horizontal position clamped between 0 and 319. It writes the vertical part to a sprite structure and updates the sprite data pointer, and it also reads the keyboard serial register.

name: set_flag_to_minus_one
description: Sets a global 16-bit flag to all ones, which is minus one.

name: clear_flag_word
description: Sets a global 16-bit flag to zero.

name: find_byte_index_in_table
description: Scans a table of 62 bytes for the byte in the data register. It returns the index it found together with the byte stored at that index.

name: compute_record_pointer
description: Computes a pointer to a 76-byte record from the index in the data register and stores it in a global. A following empty loop does no further work.

name: call_auto_request_library
description: Calls the intuition library's request routine through a library base pointer held in a global, then returns.

name: run_flag_dependent_call_sequence
description: Runs a loop of seven calls and writes two fixed values to globals. It then branches on the flags returned by further calls and runs a different series of calls in each branch.

name: setup_audio_channel_zero
description: Programs audio channel zero by setting its sample pointer, length, period and volume registers. It then enables that channel's DMA through the DMA control register.

name: step_channel_values_until_wrap
description: Sets two channel parameter globals, then loops calling a routine while stepping a byte by four until it wraps to zero. It finishes by clearing the DMA-related flag through a call.

name: step_channel_values_by_two
description: Sets two channel parameter globals, then loops calling a routine while stepping a byte by two until it wraps to zero. It finishes by clearing a flag and enabling DMA through calls.

name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls one other routine with no arguments and then returns, doing nothing else.

name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls one other routine with no arguments and then returns, doing nothing else.

name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls one other routine with no arguments and then returns, doing nothing else.

name: plot_points_from_byte_pairs
description: Sets the graphics pen to one, then loops over a table of byte pairs. It computes a point position from each pair and calls routines to plot each point.

name: call_write_pixel
description: Calls the graphics library routine that writes one pixel, passing a rastport pointer held in a global, and then returns.

name: draw_nested_offset_pattern
description: Runs nested loops over a table of counts, calling routines three times per inner step and adjusting two position globals by a signed step that flips sign on each outer pass. It finishes with two more adjustments and further calls.

name: set_position_from_lookup_tables
description: Looks up two values in tables indexed by a register, stores them in two globals with fixed offsets added, and calls one routine.

name: countdown_until_flag_bit
description: Counts down a value derived from its input until a bit in a global flag is set. It clears that bit and returns a pair whose low word is all ones.

name: pack_four_bitplane_pixels
description: Walks rectangular regions of a 320-by-200 screen stored as four bitplanes 8000 bytes apart. It reads one byte from each plane and combines the bits into a pixel value, and it writes the audio period register as part of its update.

name: fill_four_bitplane_bytes
description: Fills runs of bytes in each of four bitplanes, spaced 8000 bytes apart, with one global value. It advances row by row across a rectangle.

name: pass_through_register_pair
description: Calls one other routine and returns its two register arguments unchanged as a pair.

name: pass_through_register_pair
description: Calls one other routine and returns its two register arguments unchanged as a pair.

name: blit_then_wait_for_frame
description: Calls the graphics library bit-map blit routine and then waits for the top of the next video frame.

name: blit_then_wait_for_frame
description: Calls the graphics library bit-map blit routine and then waits for the top of the next video frame.

name: blit_then_wait_for_frame
description: Calls the graphics library bit-map blit routine and then waits for the top of the next video frame.

name: scan_wrapping_table_entries
description: Sets a display-control mask and a colour register value, then loops over a 512-entry table. It skips entries equal to the 255 marker and wraps to the start at the end of the table.

name: draw_prompt_text_loop
description: Draws text from a table of prompt strings. It sets colour registers, loops over the table skipping the 255 marker, and calls nine routines to draw each entry; the referenced text includes PRESS <SPACE> and ULTIMA III.

name: run_three_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls three routines one after another with no arguments and does no other work.

name: render_text_row_buffer
description: Waits for the top of the video frame, then remaps bytes of a 121-byte buffer that fall in a fixed range. It then loops over rows, reading four plane pointers and writing bytes to the display.

name: copy_tile_to_four_planes
description: Copies a 16-row, four-plane block from a table entry selected by a byte into the display buffers. Each row advances 40 bytes, the width of one screen row in bytes.

name: start_audio_channel_by_index
description: Starts a sound on audio channel three using a table entry chosen by an index. It sets the channel's pointer, length, period and volume registers and controls the DMA and interrupt enable bits. It returns its two register arguments unchanged.

name: busy_wait_delay
description: Stores a value into a field of a structure and then busy-waits by counting down a nested loop whose outer count is held in a register.

name: toggle_flag_and_set_fields
description: Toggles bit zero of a global flag and writes fixed 16-bit values into fields of a block addressed by an address register. One branch also sets a field to 1024.

name: set_three_channel_fields
description: Writes three fixed 16-bit values, 8 and then 1024 twice, into fields of a block addressed by an address register.

name: install_interrupt_and_build_table
description: Installs an interrupt vector for interrupt number ten, zeroes a set of globals, and builds a table by reading pairs of bytes from a source array. It finally sets bit zero of a global.

name: call_routine_sixteen_times
description: Calls one routine sixteen times in a row with no arguments, then returns.

name: reset_three_audio_channels
description: Points audio channels zero to two at a shared sample buffer, sets their length registers to 128 and their volume registers to zero, and sets the global volume to 63.

name: call_if_flag_bit_set
description: Calls one routine only when bit seven of a global flag is set; otherwise it returns without doing anything.

name: advance_sound_channel_state
description: Walks a table of sound channel entries and advances each one. It updates a level by a stored step, reads the next command, and writes the channel's period, length and volume registers, enabling DMA when a channel starts.

name: read_next_table_byte
description: Reads the byte at the current position of a table, advances the position word stored alongside it, and returns the byte. Its masking helper keeps only the low byte.

name: find_matching_slot_index
description: Searches an 8-entry byte table from the end for an entry that equals two byte values held in an address-register block, and returns the index of the match.

name: step_position_within_bounds
description: Advances two position bytes by their step values while both stay below 11. At each step it calls routines to read a value and write it to a target.

name: read_direction_codes_until_end
description: Reads direction codes in a loop, setting a step pair for each recognised code, until the terminating code is seen. It then sets a default step and updates the position by that step.

name: apply_direction_code_loop
description: Maps a direction code to a step pair, then keeps reading further codes until the terminating code, updating the position after each step.

name: update_position_from_step
description: Adds the two step values to the two position bytes and stores the results in the position fields.

name: test_byte_nonzero_flag
description: Returns one when the byte in the data register is nonzero and zero otherwise, with a sign test between the two outcomes.

name: test_shifted_byte_nonzero
description: Shifts the data register byte left by two and returns one when the result is nonzero, otherwise zero.

name: return_without_work
description: Has no visible body after decoding, so it only returns to its caller.

name: read_table_entry_by_offset
description: Computes a table index from a register byte multiplied by eleven plus a second byte, and returns the table byte at that index.

name: check_code_against_level_range
description: Checks a level field against a fixed range and compares the input byte against several codes. It returns zero from one of two paths.

name: dispatch_when_code_not_special
description: Tests the byte in the data register against four codes. When it matches none of them, it calls one routine.

name: process_entries_until_limit
description: Sets three flag bytes to all ones, then loops over entries up to a limit byte. It skips a set of codes and calls routines to process each remaining entry.

name: copy_field_byte
description: Copies one byte field of a block to another field in the same block.

name: map_command_code_after_read
description: Calls one routine to read a command, then compares the command byte in the block against a long list of codes and selects an action for each match.

name: map_command_code_to_action
description: Compares the command byte in the block against a long list of codes and selects an action for each match.

name: reset_state_and_rewrite_markers
description: Stores a global into a state field and clears two more fields, then calls routines. It rewrites the bytes marked with two letter codes in a 32-byte buffer to a fixed value before further setup.

name: loop_entries_until_end_code
description: Loops backward over a count held in the block, storing the current mode and calling routines to read each entry. When an entry is one of two end codes it copies table values into the block.

name: fill_masked_table_entries
description: Repeatedly reads a byte, uses its low three bits to test a global table, then stores the byte ORed with fifteen into a table entry and copies it into two block fields. It stops when its counter becomes negative.

name: xor_longword_into_eight_bytes
description: Reads a 32-bit value into a block field, then XORs its four bytes into four global byte locations and into four more locations spaced eight bytes apart.

name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls one other routine with no arguments and then returns, doing nothing else.

name: process_zero_terminated_byte_stream
description: Reads bytes from a zero-terminated stream. A byte of minus one calls a routine, and any other byte calls a routine and increments a counter byte in the block.

name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two routines one after the other with no arguments and then returns.

name: write_glyph_to_four_planes
description: Computes a screen offset from a row byte and a column byte, then writes eight bytes from a source table, ANDed with a global mask, into the four bitplane buffers at that offset.

name: copy_glyph_rows_to_plane
description: Computes a screen offset from two block bytes, then copies eight source bytes into one bitplane, placing each byte on successive rows 40 bytes apart.

name: process_byte_stream_after_setup
description: Calls one routine, then processes a zero-terminated byte stream, calling a routine for each byte until the terminator.

name: reset_position_and_return_pair
description: Calls one routine, sets two block position bytes to 24, and returns its two register arguments as a pair.

name: emit_value_and_advance_counter
description: Chooses one of two global values depending on whether the input byte equals 29, passes it to a routine, then calls another routine and increments a counter byte in the block.

name: copy_rows_to_four_planes
description: Writes eight source bytes into the four bitplanes at a column offset, advancing 40 bytes per row.

name: clear_rows_and_set_mask
description: Calls routines in a nine-pass loop, then sets a 32-bit colour mask global to a fixed value.

name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two routines one after the other with no arguments and then returns.

name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls one other routine with no arguments and then returns, doing nothing else.

name: clear_plane_rows_to_zero
description: Clears rows of four bitplanes by writing zero bytes and zero longwords at offsets that advance through each plane. A counter loop repeats the clear over a band of rows.

name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls one other routine with no arguments and then returns, doing nothing else.

name: clear_bitmap_buffer
description: Clears a 32000-byte bitmap buffer through the graphics library clear routine, using the buffer address from the block, and returns its two register arguments.

name: invert_bytes_at_table_offsets
description: Looks up a screen offset in a table by a counter and complements the bytes at eight row offsets of the bitplane. A flag selects which of two paths is taken first.

name: invert_eight_rows_at_offset
description: Complements eight bytes of a bitplane spaced 40 bytes apart, starting from an offset in the data register.

name: select_argument_then_call
description: Calls one routine for a value, then either passes that value and the address register to a second routine or calls a third routine. It finishes by calling one more routine.

name: select_argument_then_call
description: Calls one routine for a value, then either passes that value and the address register to a second routine or calls a third routine. It finishes by calling one more routine.

name: return_pair_after_call
description: Calls one routine and then returns its two register arguments as a pair.

name: call_and_advance_counter
description: Calls one routine and then increments a counter byte in the block.

name: call_two_then_advance_counter
description: Calls two routines and then increments a counter byte in the block.

name: call_and_advance_counter
description: Calls one routine and then increments a counter byte in the block.

name: return_data_register_shifted_six
description: Returns the 16-bit value in the data register shifted left by six bits and does nothing else.

name: clear_buffer_and_copy_rows
description: Clears 64 longwords of a global buffer, then copies 16-byte rows from a source buffer while a routine's returned count is nonzero, advancing the source each time.

name: copy_rows_until_zero
description: Copies 16-byte rows from a source buffer to a destination, calling a routine to advance the source on each pass, until the count it returns is zero.

name: decode_command_byte_stream
description: Reads command bytes in a loop. Bytes from 176 to 185 are stored as a column offset and advance a row counter, and byte 141 copies the stored offset into a second field before further reads.

name: decode_command_stream_from_code
description: Handles code 136 by stepping the row counter back one and running the same column-offset decoding loop. Codes from 176 to 185 are decoded the same way.

name: decode_offset_code_range
description: Handles a code byte from 176 to 185 by storing it as an offset, advancing the row counter and reading further codes until a terminating code. It then steps the row counter back.

name: compute_offset_fields_from_counter
description: Multiplies a counter byte into a running value that adds ten per step. It then stores that value plus a base byte, and a packed row-and-column byte, into two block fields.

name: reduce_value_modulo_field
description: Subtracts a block field from a value repeatedly until the value is smaller than the field, then stores the remainder back in that field.

name: run_six_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls six routines one after another in a fixed order and does no other work.

name: tick_two_countdown_timers
description: Decrements two counter bytes in the block. Each counter that reaches zero is reloaded to two and triggers a routine call, and the routine calls around them continue in sequence.

name: run_three_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls three routines one after another with no arguments and does no other work.

name: tick_countdown_reloading_to_three
description: Decrements a counter byte in the block and, when it reaches zero, reloads it to three and calls a routine.

name: tick_countdown_reloading_to_two
description: Decrements a counter byte in the block and, when it reaches zero, reloads it to two and calls a routine.

name: tick_countdown_reloading_to_one
description: Decrements a counter byte and, when it reaches zero, reloads it to one and calls a routine. It then calls another routine.

name: shuffle_word_table_entries
description: When a flag byte is set, rearranges 16-bit words in a table. It reads offsets from a constant table, swaps word pairs, and calls one routine afterwards.

name: rotate_word_bitplane_left_one
description: Calls one routine, then rotates a set of 16-bit words left by one bit, one per row of the bitplane table.

name: rotate_block_words_left_one
description: Rotates several 16-bit words in a block left by one bit, each at a fixed offset.

name: decrement_signed_table_counters
description: Walks a table of 121 signed counter bytes, decrementing the magnitude of each. When a counter goes below zero it calls a routine for a new low nibble and resets the sign.

name: process_stream_from_start_position
description: Stores two starting values into the block and then processes a zero-terminated byte stream, calling a routine for each byte and advancing a counter byte.

name: return_counter_shifted_six
description: Returns a counter byte from the block shifted left by six bits, as a 16-bit value.

name: measure_string_and_emit_characters
description: Measures a zero-terminated string, stores half its length in a block field, sets a start column from that, then calls routines for each character until the terminator.

name: return_without_work
description: Has no visible body after decoding, so it only returns to its caller.

name: read_grid_cell_value
description: Copies two block position bytes into their paired slots, then returns the grid table byte at column plus row times 64.

name: read_grid_cell_at_position
description: Returns the grid table byte at column plus row times 64, using the two block position bytes.

name: cycle_animation_frame_index
description: Decrements a counter. When it goes negative it reloads the counter to eight and cycles a stored index through values in steps of four, then draws with two routine calls.

name: test_code_matches_pending_state
description: Returns a flag that is set when the input byte equals a stored code or that code is zero, and a state byte equals 22.

name: increment_multibyte_counter
description: Adds a seed byte plus carry across a 16-byte counter from byte 14 down to byte zero, then increments byte 15 until no carry remains.

name: add_decimal_digits_bcd
description: Adds a value to a packed-decimal counter, applying decimal adjustment to each byte of the counter in turn.

name: store_pair_and_poll
description: Stores two bytes into the block and loops calling routines until a flag reported by a routine clears, then returns a value.

name: shift_eight_byte_history
description: Decrements a counter. When it reaches zero it resets the counter to 45 and shifts an eight-byte history buffer one slot, placing the new value at the front.

name: scan_neighbourhood_grid_cells
description: Scans a 64-by-64 grid around a position, reading cells within a window and combining their values with a shifted bit test. It then calls a routine to store the result.

name: copy_grid_block_to_planes
description: Copies a 10-by-10 block of grid cells into four bitplanes, expanding each cell's bits into one byte per plane at computed screen offsets.

name: remap_cells_and_copy_planes
description: Remaps grid bytes in a range by adding 96 where the high bit is set, then copies the grid into the bitplanes at screen offsets.

name: read_byte_through_pointer_table
description: Looks up a pointer in a table by index, then returns the byte it points to, placed in the high byte of the result word.

name: countdown_then_wait_for_frame
description: Decrements a counter and, when it reaches zero, calls a routine. It then waits for the top of the video frame and calls two routines.

name: scroll_word_column_rows
description: Repeats three times, shifting each entry of a 16-word block down one position and moving the last entry to the front, so the words scroll through the block.

name: run_three_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls three routines one after another with no arguments and does no other work.

name: read_fire_button_state
description: Reads the fire button register and the right and middle mouse button register. It updates button flags in the block and calls routines when a button state changes.

name: read_table_byte_by_index
description: Returns the byte of a global table selected by the index in the data register.

name: set_flag_once_and_call
description: If a global flag is zero, sets it to minus one and calls a routine. Otherwise it does nothing.

name: clear_flag_and_call
description: If a global flag is nonzero, clears it to zero and calls a routine.

name: test_point_inside_rectangle
description: Returns a flag that is set when the point in the data registers lies inside the rectangle stored in the block. Lower bounds are inclusive and upper bounds are exclusive.

name: act_if_point_in_rectangle
description: Tests whether the point in the data registers lies inside a rectangle held in a block, and calls a routine when it does.

name: update_cell_under_pointer
description: Compares the current pointer coordinates with the last recorded ones. When they differ, it converts them into a grid cell index by subtracting offsets and dividing by sixteen, then stores the new position.

name: reset_word_and_call_routines
description: Sets a global word to minus one and calls several routines. It calls one more routine only when a mode byte equals one.

name: map_pointer_to_grid_cell
description: Converts a pointer position into a grid cell index, using offsets of eight horizontally and twelve vertically with sixteen-pixel cells, clamped to ten cells. It then calls routines to act on that cell.

name: set_mode_five_if_changed
description: Sets a global mode byte to five and calls a routine only when the byte was not already five.

name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls one other routine with no arguments and then returns, doing nothing else.

name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls one other routine with no arguments and then returns, doing nothing else.

name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls one other routine with no arguments and then returns. The decompiled body shows only that call, so no further behaviour can be read from it.

name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls one other routine with no arguments and then returns, doing nothing else.

name: build_absolute_jump_table
description: Writes twenty six-byte absolute jump instructions, each followed by a 32-bit target address copied from a source table.

name: wait_until_call_succeeds
description: Clears bit seven of a flag register, then loops calling a routine with a minus one argument until it returns a value other than minus one while a global is nonzero.

name: retry_file_read_until_success
description: Loops calling a routine with the mode minus two until it returns a value other than minus one while a global is nonzero. The program references the file name ULTMAPS/SOSA.BIN.

name: save_restore_position_around_call
description: Saves two position bytes and a global word, calls one routine, then restores the saved values.

name: classify_code_at_position
description: Reads a cell code at the block position and maps the value 64 to the constant 199. It stores the result when it changes and calls a routine on each change.

name: update_entity_at_position
description: Reads a cell code at the block position and updates the stored code when it changes. It sets two position bytes to 24, then branches on a counter byte to run a series of calls.

name: branch_on_cell_code
description: Sets two position bytes to 24 and decrements a counter when it is nonzero. It reads the cell code at the position and calls routines according to the code's value.

name: enter_entity_branch_block
description: Enters the shared entity branch block after a short prologue and calls one routine.

name: enter_entity_branch_block
description: Enters the shared entity branch block after a short prologue and calls one routine.

name: count_flagged_cells
description: Reads a position and a cell flag. When flag bit five is set and the position is nonnegative, it increments a counter byte and calls a routine; otherwise it follows the shared branch.

name: decrement_counter_on_flag_bit
description: When flag bit four is set, decrements a counter byte in the block and calls a routine while the counter stays nonnegative. Otherwise it follows the shared branch.

name: reset_position_and_flags
description: Copies two stored position bytes into the current position, sets a mode byte to minus one and clears a flag. It calls several routines and then sets a global to one.

name: decrement_bcd_counter_then_branch
description: Calls two routines, then decrements a packed-decimal counter at a fixed offset when it is not zero, before entering the shared entity branch.

name: decrement_bcd_counter_then_branch
description: Decrements a packed-decimal counter when it is nonzero, then enters the shared entity branch block.

name: set_bcd_counter_from_input
description: Stores the input byte minus one as a packed-decimal value in a counter, then enters the shared entity branch block.

name: set_pair_constants_and_branch
description: Sets two global values to ten and four, calls a routine, then enters the shared entity branch block.

name: dispatch_entity_state_branch
description: Shared entity branch block. It sets two position bytes to 24, decrements a counter when it is nonzero, reads the cell at the position and runs one of several call sequences depending on the returned value.

name: run_sequence_for_input_one
description: When the input byte equals one, clears a state byte, calls a routine sequence that includes a loop, and sets a global to four. Other inputs take the remaining branches.

name: run_entity_action_sequences
description: Runs a long sequence of routine calls that includes a repeating loop, sets a global to four, and continues into the shared branch block.

name: loop_entity_update_with_flags
description: Loops copying two saved state bytes, setting two position bytes to 24 and calling routines. It sets a flag to zero, makes a call, sets the flag to one and branches on the returned value.

name: loop_entity_update_with_flags
description: Makes nine routine calls in a loop, then sets two position bytes to 24, toggles a flag around one call and branches on the returned value.

name: loop_classify_cell_codes
description: Loops over cells, reading the cell code at the block position, mapping the value 64 to 199 and storing it when it changes, then calling routines for each cell.

name: build_bit_mask_from_count
description: Builds a single-bit mask by shifting one left by the count in a register, and returns the mask.

name: read_table_byte_by_position
description: Returns a byte from a table indexed by a block byte multiplied by 256 and by the position bytes shifted left by four. The block byte is returned in the high position.

name: xor_buffer_with_rotating_key
description: XORs a 2048-byte buffer with four key bytes taken from the block. The key bytes rotate on each step so that each buffer byte is combined with a different key byte.
